recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, smiling male portrait rendered in a painterly, impressionist style with visible impasto-like brushstrokes, set against a heavily textured pink and lavender background with gold-flecked accents. The composition features high-contrast inline display type at the top and elegant, slanted script on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's warm skin tones against cool pink background
Geometric inline header vs. organic script subtitle
Rough painterly texture vs. clean typographic lines
Centralized figure providing a stable anchor for asymmetrical text
coreInvariants: Smiling male subject in formal attire

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered bust-up portrait, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top header, moves down to the subject's face, then right to the script text, and finally to the logo in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Active negative space filled with expressive, multi-tonal brushstrokes in pink, white, and ochre.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pink and Lavender (background and highlights on clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Brown and Black (hair, eyes, and bowtie)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and Ochre (background flecks and skin undertones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, medium saturation background contrasting with low value, high detail facial features.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses a double-line inline effect within a medium-weight sans-serif skeleton.
Subtitle text uses a rhythmic, connected formal script with a consistent rightward slant.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Inline strokes must maintain consistent distance from the outer boundary of the glyphs.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the background space to the right of the face

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, architectural header with a soft, handwritten-style subtitle.
graphicDevices: Angled rectangular badge in bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and inline decorative style of the header.
Captures the mid-century formal script aesthetic for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an oil painting of a smiling Black man in a white shirt and patterned bowtie. Use an impressionist style with heavy, visible brushstrokes. The background should be a textured mix of pink, lavender, and white with small flecks of gold leaf. Leave space at the top and to the right for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large centered header in an inline geometric sans-serif font at the top. Add a three-line stacked subtitle in a formal script font to the right of the subject's face. Place a small angled black rectangle with white text in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait rendered with painterly texture rather than a photo?
Does the header text feature an inline double-stroke?
Is the script text lowercase and slanted?
Is the color palette dominated by pink and lavender tones?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Check for visible impasto brushwork in the background.
Ensure the inline font is legible and centered.
Verify the script text has a consistent flow and slant.
Confirm the subject's skin tones are rich and multi-tonal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Impressionist Portrait + Pink Textured Background + Inline Sans Header + Script Subtitle
